SELECT 
    s.modtype AS mod_type,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.modindex * (1 + (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000)) * s.sigdursec / (1 + COALESCE(s.doppshifthz, 0) / 1000)) * 
        CASE WHEN s.modtype = 'AM' THEN 2 WHEN s.modtype = 'FM' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1 END) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_mcs,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.snrratio) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_snr
FROM signals s
GROUP BY s.modtype
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY count DESC;

WITH signal_mcs AS (
    SELECT 
        s.signalregistry,
        s.modtype,
        ROUND(CAST(s.modindex * (1 + (1 - ABS(s.freqdrifthzs) / (s.freqmhz * 1000)) * s.sigdursec / (1 + COALESCE(s.doppshifthz, 0) / 1000)) * 
            CASE WHEN s.modtype = 'AM' THEN 2 WHEN s.modtype = 'FM' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1 END AS numeric), 4) AS mcs,
        ROUND(CAST(s.snrratio AS numeric), 4) AS snr
    FROM signals s
),
signal_json AS (
    SELECT 
        modtype,
        json_agg(json_build_object(signalregistry, json_build_object('mcs', mcs, 'snr', snr))) AS signal_details

)
